entities.name: Juan Manuel Suárez Fernández
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan Manuel Suárez Fernández also known by Juanma Suárez was a Spanish punk rock bassist and singer, founder and member of one of the most influential Spanish punk rock bands, Eskorbuto, since 1980 to 1992. With Iosu Expósito founded a previous band called Sección Mortuoria, then Muñecas de Acero. His friend, Roberto Moso, gave them the nickname "Eskorbuto" for their scrawny look. He is widely considered an icon of Spanish punk.
